title: ononis spinosa subsp. spinosiformis
intro: Ononis spinosa subsp. spinosiformis, commonly known as Spiny Restharrow, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, making it a potential treatment for urinary tract infections and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Spiny Restharrow include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and increase urine production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
